flaw_diagnosis.standard: NIST AI RMF / WCAG 2.2 / Modern Chat UX
flaw_diagnosis.flaw: Frontend UI lacks dedicated document upload/attachment drag-and-drop affordance in taxpayer chat view
flaw_diagnosis.impact: Users cannot visually discover or attach invoices/receipts directly in the browser without developer API calls
flaw_diagnosis.remedy: Expose an attachment button (paperclip icon) in the ChatV2 composer with progress indicator, chip preview, and instant report download link.

flaw_diagnosis.flaw: Synchronous OCR processing blocks HTTP worker thread for multi-page scanned documents
flaw_diagnosis.impact: Scanned PDFs taking >30s can hit cloud gateway / ngrok tunnel timeouts (e.g. 504 Gateway Timeout)
flaw_diagnosis.remedy: Return 202 Accepted with polling job status (GET /v1/documents/{id}/status) for files requiring multi-page OCR.

flaw_diagnosis.flaw: Document analysis reports are generated synchronously on each GET request without client-side ETag / Cache-Control
flaw_diagnosis.impact: Repeated downloads re-render the PDF from scratch, consuming CPU cycles on report generation
flaw_diagnosis.remedy: Attach ETag header derived from DocumentRecord hash and Cache-Control: private, no-transform, max-age=300.
